'''Neb Ufentes''' was a noted [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] and expert in [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] theory. He was contracted by [[Drooim-Durtha Systems]] to create the [[ShipFinder]] [[Homing beacon/Legends|subspace tracking beacon]]. After perfecting the device, Ufentes was killed when his lab on the edge of the [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]] was raided by the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Mahk'khar]].
